parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host for which you want to modify project information.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改项目信息的堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the project that you want to modify.
You can call the ListProjects operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要修改信息的项目ID。
您可以调用ListProjects接口获取该参数
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the project. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, cannot start with a special character, and can contain only the following special characters: periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), backslashes (), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的项目名称。长度为1-128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的'.'、'_'、'-'、'\'以及空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new description of the project. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的项目备注信息。最多支持 500 字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The UIDs of the member accounts to associate with the project after modification.
You can call the ListMembersNotForProject operation to obtain this parameter. If you do not specify this parameter, no changes are made
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后项目中要关联的成员账号UID。
您可以调用ListMembersNotForProject接口获取该参数。不传表示不做修改
parameters.name: member_ids

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
